name: Alpha Centauri System
sources: NASA Exoplanet Archive (Proxima Cen b, c, d entries)
Kervella et al. 2017 (Proxima bound to Alpha Centauri AB)
notes: Observed local-system proxy. Alpha Centauri A/B are modeled as the observed binary, and Proxima Centauri is represented as a wide companion to Alpha Centauri A because this manifest format cannot encode the full Alpha Centauri AB barycenter hierarchy exactly. Only archive-listed planets are included, and candidate planets remain labeled as such.

stars.name: Alpha Centauri A
stars.notes: Observed primary star in the Alpha Centauri A/B binary.

stars.name: Alpha Centauri B
stars.notes: Observed secondary star in the Alpha Centauri A/B binary; orbital elements approximate the published visual-binary solution within the manifest hierarchy.

stars.name: Proxima Centauri
stars.notes: Wide companion proxy for the Alpha Centauri AB barycenter; semimajor axis and period are kept mutually consistent even though the hierarchy cannot encode the true AB barycenter directly.

planets.name: Proxima d
planets.notes: Confirmed RV planet; radius is visualization-only because no transit radius is measured.

planets.name: Proxima b
planets.notes: Confirmed nearby exoplanet; radius is visualization-only because no transit radius is measured.

planets.name: Proxima c (candidate)
planets.notes: Long-period candidate planet; rendered as a visualization-only placeholder until its planetary nature is confirmed.
